body:
## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided audio tour in Memphis, United States. The listing gives its length as 2 hours, over a route of about 2 miles. It starts at Memphis Rock 'n' Soul Museum, 191 Beale Street. An entry ticket is part of the package; the listing includes: General admission to Memphis Rock 'n' Soul Museum. There is no live guide: the tour plays in the WeGoTrip app on your own phone.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> With this ticket to the Memphis Rock 'n' Soul Museum and a self-guided city walk, you'll explore a lively city along the Mississippi River known as the home of the Blues and famous for its contribution to the culture and history of the U.S.
>
> The tour begins at the Memphis Rock 'n' Soul Museum, a brainchild of the Smithsonian Institute, which pays tribute to Tennesee's early pioneers of blues, rock, and soul. (!) Note that this tour includes an entrance ticket available in the app and the audio guide of the city. An audio guide inside the museum is provided on a separate device.
>
> After you finish exploring the museum, unpause this tour and set off on a fascinating stroll through Memphis' famous landmarks, concluding at the world‐renowned Blues Foundation. You will walk along iconic Beale Street, visit a wonderful Mississippi River Park with breathtaking views of steep valleys, look at the jewel of Memphis, the famous Orpheum Theatre, and more!
>
> This tour will take you through the city's downtown, showing its must-see places and a few more good-to-explore attractions of an entertainment district with strong ties to Blues Music, which flows from every corner.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €16.93. It was rated 4.6 out of 5 from 17 ratings and 16 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
